name: Aerobic methanotroph (coarse lumped black box; M. capsulatus Bath yield)

provenance.ref: CH2O0.5N0.25 standard microbial C-mole formula (~25.5 g/C-mol); biomass unit here = C4H8O2N = 4x monomer
Methylococcus capsulatus (Bath) ~0.64 g dry wt / g CH4 -> molar carbon-conversion efficiency ~0.40 C-to-biomass; methanotroph biocatalyst literature incl. mSphere 2024 doi:10.1128/msphere.00496-24

COARSE LUMPED single growth reaction: 10 CH4 + 15.75 O2 + NH4+ -> C4H8O2N + 6 CO2 + 17.5 H2O + H+ ; CCE and biomass formula are cited, all coefficients then fixed by C/H/O/N/charge conservation (documented in scripts/build_methanotroph.py). NOMINAL/coarse: no mechanistic pathway, no methanol/formaldehyde intermediates, no maintenance term.

notes: A fit-for-purpose METHANE-CAPTURE unit and the aerobic mirror of fba_methanogen (a methane PRODUCER). At optimum it CONSUMES methane + O2 + ammonium and produces biomass (single-cell protein) + CO2 + H2O -- captures/transforms the greenhouse gas CH4 into useful biomass. Deliberately a COARSE black box built from published yield (no local methanotroph GEM; BiGG/EBI unreachable), honestly labelled: the lumped stoichiometry is authoritative-yield-grounded, not a mechanistic reconstruction. Its Eh window is OXIC (aerobe), disjoint from the methanogen's reducing window, so the composition-validity gate correctly refuses to co-mix a methane producer and an aerobic methane consumer in one well-mixed medium.

validity.note: coarse lumped FBA; obligate aerobe (needs O2). Single growth reaction; fluxes mmol/gDW/h-scale, nominal.
